caption:
Toto bowls over after over every Saturday, and by Monday the lower back feels stiff.

Bowling asks the trunk to twist and side-bend fast, again and again. Building bowling load gradually before the season and working on trunk control can help.

Hybi's cricket Pilates: dead bug 8 each side, side plank 20 seconds × 3 each side, four-point trunk rotation 8 each side. Two to three times a week, in a comfortable range.

Pain every time you bowl, or leg tingling, is worth an assessment first. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🏏

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
